posts.description: AI often feels powerful because it hides the complexity, but as an engineer, your job is to manage that complexity, not ignore it. The tools have changed, but the fundamental requirement for engineering rigour has never been higher. — Chris Gregori in Code Is Cheap Now. Software Isn’t.
